name: self_heal_triage_20261108
comment: The self-heal fixer had no reading step: nothing classified a failure, nothing linked the
FINDING-SELF-HEAL-* notes for earlier occurrences, nothing wrote a root-cause paragraph.
scripts/lib/self_heal_triage.py adds it as advisory-only triage on DeepSeek flash through the
governed client, gated to the operator's scheduled window (weekday 09:00-21:00 ET, any weekend
hour) and a pre-send $0.05 cap, 60 s, one attempt, no repair. Pins: class=None on every failure
(rules decide), schema-validated output with extra keys forbidden, linked paths only from the
supplied FINDING-SELF-HEAL candidates, embedded fence markers neutralised, and no write/command
surface in the module. The LLM is stubbed throughout; no test reaches the network.
